estimate.under: Based on {{n}} tasks ({{basis}}) you usually need {{pct}}% more time than you expect.
estimate.over: Based on {{n}} tasks ({{basis}}) you usually finish {{pct}}% faster than you expect.

warning.buffer-squeezed: This only fits by working right up to the deadline.
warning.deadline-passed: The deadline has passed while work is still open.

feedback.actual: How much time did you spend in total?
feedback.sessions: Did you need more or fewer moments?

reopen.introFeedback: Thanks! The task isn't finished yet. Do you want to replan the rest?
reopen.remaining: How much time is still needed?
reopen.deadlineHint: The old deadline has passed: choose a new one.

busy.intro: Time when you can't work, such as lessons, meetings, sports or a job. Planora plans around it.
busy.title: Description
busy.errTime: The end must be after the start.
busy.externalIntro: This event comes from {{source}} and can only be changed there. Here you can set what kind of event it is.

calendar.hint: Drag across an empty area to add an event. Drag a Planora block to move it; it then stays pinned.

review.nothingYet: No completed tasks with feedback this week yet.
review.noHistoryHint: Every week Planora makes a plan and a review that are kept here.

improve.daypart: You miss most blocks in the {{daypart}} ({{n}} times). Plan less then or pick other times.
improve.estimate: For {{label}} you need {{pct}}% more time than you estimate on average. Planora now plans extra time for it.
improve.moreTime: {{n}} tasks didn't have enough time. Start earlier or plan bigger blocks.
improve.lessPerDay: You completed {{pct}}% of your blocks. Try planning fewer hours per day.
improve.deadlines: {{n}} deadline(s) missed. Replan the rest with a new deadline.

focus.overestimate: {{label}}: you usually finish {{pct}}% faster. Planora plans less time for it.
focus.lowCompletion: Last week you completed {{pct}}% of your blocks. Start on time and check off your blocks.
focus.daypart: Last week you mostly missed blocks in the {{daypart}}. Pay extra attention then.
focus.heavyDay: {{date}} will be a busy day. Keep the rest of that day light.
focus.busyWeek: {{n}} deadlines this week: start with the first one.
focus.keepGoing: A calm week. Work through your blocks and you're on schedule.

import.title: Tasks from Microsoft To Do / Teams
import.error: Fetching failed. Please try again later.
import.linkHint: Keeps your estimate and planned blocks.

lock.title: Planora is locked
lock.intro: Your data is encrypted. Enter your passphrase.

notify.planBody: See what's planned for this week.
notify.reviewBody: How did this week go? See what went well and what could be better.

integrations.builtinIntro: Planora has its own calendar that always works, even without any connections. Everything then stays on this device.
integrations.privacyPromise: Connecting is optional. Linked data travels directly between this device and Microsoft or Google, never through a Planora server. You decide per feature what Planora may do, and you can disconnect at any time; everything Planora fetched is then erased.
integrations.microsoftIntro: Use your busy times from Outlook (including Teams meetings) and optionally put your blocks in your Outlook calendar.
integrations.notConfigured: This connection isn't set up yet. Whoever installs Planora must register the app once with Microsoft or Google and put the client ID in the .env file. The steps are in README.md in the Planora project folder.
integrations.connectHint: A Microsoft sign-in window opens. Planora first only asks to read your calendar.
integrations.staySignedInHint: Keeps the sign-in on this device. Off: sign in again after closing the browser.
integrations.readBusyHint: Only start and end times and whether you're busy. No titles, content or attendees.
integrations.showTitlesHint: Titles stay on this device only.
integrations.writeSessionsHint: As private events. Planora only changes or deletes events it created itself.
integrations.genericTitlesHint: Shows ‘Planora focus’ instead of your task name.
integrations.importTodo: Fetch tasks from Microsoft To Do
integrations.importHint: You choose which tasks to take over.
integrations.importTeamsHint: School accounts only. Your school admin may need to allow this first.
integrations.disconnectBody: Planora forgets your sign-in and erases all fetched calendar data from this device.
integrations.removeEvents: Also remove the Planora events from Outlook
integrations.revokeHint: Want to revoke the permission at Microsoft as well? You can do that at
integrations.googleIntro: Use only your free/busy times from Google Calendar. Planora can't see titles or content.
integrations.googleExpired: Google keeps Planora signed in for an hour at a time. Busy times already fetched stay; refresh with one click when you want the latest.
integrations.googleBrowserHint: A browser window opens to sign in with Google; afterwards you return to Planora (on a computer: switch back to Planora yourself).

ics.title: Apple Calendar and other calendars (.ics)
ics.intro: No account or password: you exchange files. Files are read on this device only.
ics.howMac: Mac: open Calendar, select the calendar and choose File > Export > Export. Import that file here.
ics.howIphone: iPhone: the Calendar app can't export by itself. Do it on a Mac with the same iCloud calendar, or add your schedule in Planora itself.
ics.howOther: Other calendars (Outlook, Google, school timetable): export or download an .ics file and import it here.
ics.exportIphone: iPhone: tap Export and choose 'Add All'. Preferably pick a separate 'Planora' calendar.
ics.exportAndroid: Android: tap Export and choose your calendar app in the share menu.
ics.exportMac: Mac/PC: open the downloaded file; it is added to your calendar.
ics.exportRefresh: Plan changed? Export again: existing blocks are updated, not duplicated.
ics.genericHint: Shows 'Planora focus' instead of task names in the file.
ics.categoryHint: Tests ("toets", "tentamen", …) and excursions are recognised by their name. You can change single events by clicking them in the calendar.
ics.alsoInOutlook: This file is also in your Outlook calendar. You can remove it if you like; nothing breaks either way.

privacy.badge: Your data stays on this device
privacy.local: All your tasks, plans and feedback are stored on this device only.
privacy.noServer: Planora has no server and no account: there is nothing to leak.
privacy.connections: Active connections: {{list}}. Only what you turn on is fetched.
privacy.encryptionIntro: Encrypt your data on this device with a passphrase. Without it nobody can read your tasks, even with access to your device.
privacy.encryptionOn: Your data is encrypted. Planora asks for your passphrase when it opens.
privacy.pwWarning: Careful: if you lose the passphrase, nobody can recover your data. Make a backup too.
privacy.backupIntro: A backup is always encrypted with a passphrase you choose.
privacy.exportHint: Choose a passphrase for this backup file.
privacy.importHint: Enter the passphrase of the backup file. Your current data will be replaced.
privacy.logIntro: Every time Planora contacted Microsoft or Google. Counts only, never content.
privacy.logEmpty: No activity yet: Planora hasn't contacted anyone.
privacy.deleteIntro: Erases all Planora data on this device and signs you out of linked services.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Type ‘{{word}}’ to confirm. This can't be undone.

settings.availabilityHint: Planora only plans within these times and never over your events.
settings.lessonBufferHint: Minutes kept free after a lesson, test or excursion. 0 = off.

onboarding.intro: Add your tasks, Planora plans the moments to work on them and learns how much time you really need.
onboarding.roleIntro: This tailors the kinds of tasks to you. You can change it later.
onboarding.timeIntro: On school days (Mon to Fri). You can adjust each day later in Settings.
onboarding.timeHint: Put classes, sports and other events in the calendar; Planora plans around them.
onboarding.privacyIntegrations: Connecting Outlook, Teams or Google is optional and can be done later. You choose exactly what Planora may do.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.closeToTray: Keep running in the background when closed
desktop.closeToTrayHint: Planora stays in the system tray so weekly reminders arrive on time.
desktop.openAtLoginHint: Starts Planora hidden in the background when you sign in.

install.title: Planora on other devices / share
install.intro: Send these links to friends or use them yourself. Everyone uses Planora with their own data on their own device.
install.ownData: Everyone has their own data on their own device. Several devices yourself? Turn on Sync (optional).
install.pageHint: Recognises your device (Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iPhone) and explains installing step by step.

sync.title: Sync between your devices (optional)
sync.intro: Using Planora on more than one device, like your phone and your laptop? Keep them the same here. If you only use one device, you don't need this.
sync.point1: Planora keeps one encrypted file in its own hidden folder in your OneDrive. Planora can't see your other files and has no server of its own.
sync.point2: Everything is encrypted on your device with a passphrase only you know. Microsoft only sees unreadable data.
sync.point3: Works with a free personal Microsoft account (outlook.com/hotmail). No permission from school needed. This account is separate from the Outlook/Teams connection.
sync.notAvailable: Sync is not available in this version of Planora.
sync.signInHint: Microsoft asks permission to access the app's own folder (Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder).
sync.createIntro: This is your first device with sync. Choose a passphrase; you'll enter it on your other devices too.
sync.joinIntro: Another device already syncs. Enter the same passphrase as there.
sync.passHint: At least 8 characters. Lost means lost: without this passphrase nobody can read the data, not even Planora.
sync.stopHint: Stopping keeps your data on this device and in OneDrive.
sync.deleteRemoteIntro: The encrypted file in OneDrive is deleted and sync stops. Data on your devices stays. Other devices will then say that sync needs to be set up again.

errors.wrong-passphrase: The passphrase is not (or no longer) right. Was sync set up again on another device? Enter the new passphrase.
errors.signed-out: You are no longer signed in to Microsoft for sync.
errors.too-large: Your data is too large to sync (over 4 MB).
errors.offline: No internet. Planora will try again later.
errors.failed: Sync failed. Planora will try again later.

updates.title: Updates
updates.failed: Couldn't check; Planora will try again later.
updates.autoHint: Planora only asks GitHub what the newest version is. Nothing about you is sent.
updates.restartHint: The update is downloaded and checked. Restart now, or it's installed when you quit Planora.
updates.downloadHint: Download the new version and install it over the old one; your data is kept.
updates.androidHint: Tap Update, open the download and choose Update. Your data is kept.
